# Live-cubemap conversion differential.
# Probe Temp/opencode/cubeconvprobe: real Cubemap_2022 (class 89) and Texture2D_2022
# objects built through the generated Create API (2022.3), hand-crafted DXT5 blocks
# (uniform alpha 255, red/green 565 endpoints, flip-asymmetric color indices),
# calling the shipped TextureConverter.TryConvertToBitmap(ITexture2D, ...)
# (AssetRipper.Export.Modules.Textures.dll, SDK 10.0.401).
# Format: CCASE|<tag>|lightmap|<name>|<value>; CCASE|<tag>|input|<len>|<hex>;
# CCASE|<tag>|ok|<0|1>; CCASE|<tag>|size|<w>|<h>|<d>|<pixel-size>;
# CCASE|<tag>|pixels|<hex RGBA bytes of Bits>. 8x8 faces, 6-face cubemaps,
# Depth layers stack face after face; cubemaps skip FlipY, Texture2D flips.
CCASE|cube-normalmap|lightmap|NormalmapDXT5nm|3
CCASE|cube-normalmap|input|384|
CCASE|cube-normalmap|ok|1
CCASE|cube-normalmap|size|8|8|6|4
CCASE|cube-normalmap|pixels|
CCASE|cube-plain|lightmap|Default|0
CCASE|cube-plain|input|384|
CCASE|cube-plain|ok|1
CCASE|cube-plain|size|8|8|6|4
CCASE|cube-plain|pixels|
CCASE|tex2d-plain|lightmap|Default|0
CCASE|tex2d-plain|input|64|FFFF0000000000000020000100005555FFFF0000000000000020000100005555FFFF0000000000000020000100005555FFFF0000000000000020000100005555
CCASE|tex2d-plain|ok|1
CCASE|tex2d-plain|size|8|8|1|4
CCASE|tex2d-plain|pixels|
